ideas.pitch: A specialised visual debugging and performance profiling extension that steps through complex data structure operations in real time to pinpoint hidden algorithmic bottlenecks.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace: Visual Algorithm Debugger and Execution Optimiser
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the hackathon's core evaluation focus on debugging, algorithmic optimisation, and practical coding skills by offering an interactive developer tool rather than a generic app.

ideas.pitch: An automated stress-testing and edge-case generation tool for competitive programmers that compares naive and optimised algorithmic solutions against randomly generated adversarial inputs.
ideas.title: QueryForge: Competitive Programming Test Case Generator and Fuzzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive pain point for competitive programmers and logic-heavy challenge participants by automating test case generation and corner-case detection.

ideas.pitch: An Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) comparison tool designed for programming educators and contest hosts to detect structural code duplication and logic reuse across submissions.
ideas.title: LexiDiff: AST-Based Code Similarity and Plagiarism Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages deep computer science concepts (AST parsing and graph matching) to solve a real evaluation challenge for coding platforms, fitting the algorithmic and logic-heavy theme.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight runtime profiler that tracks memory allocations, garbage collection pauses, and cache locality misses to help developers optimise resource-constrained algorithms.
ideas.title: MemoryScope: C++ and Python Memory Profiler for Deep Optimisation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by focusing on low-level performance profiling, standing out against high-level wrappers and simple CRUD projects.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance constraint satisfaction solver and visualization engine built to tackle complex discrete mathematics, pathfinding, and combinatorial optimisation challenges.
ideas.title: LogicSolver: Automated Constraint Satisfaction and Grid Optimiser
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to judges evaluating computer science fundamentals, logic, and computational thinking through a robust, mathematically rigorous backend.
